name: Carney Complex

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Stratakis Diagnostic Criteria for Carney Complex

criteria.description: Presence of cardiac myxoma confirmed by imaging or histology
Spotty skin pigmentation including lentigines and blue nevi
Endocrine tumors such as primary pigmented nodular adrenocortical disease (PPNAD) or pituitary adenomas
Myxomas in extracardiac locations (skin, breast, etc.)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Diagnosis requires two or more major criteria or one major criterion plus a pathogenic PRKAR1A mutation or a first-degree relative with Carney Complex
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing for PRKAR1A mutations supports diagnosis but is not mandatory

pathognomonic.symptomName: Spotty skin pigmentation (lentigines and blue nevi)

common.symptomName: Pituitary adenomas causing acromegaly or Cushing disease
searchTerms: pituitary tumors causing excess growth hormone

common.symptomName: Testicular tumors (large-cell calcifying Sertoli cell tumors)

occasional.symptomName: Cushing syndrome symptoms due to PPNAD

rare.symptomName: Stroke secondary to cardiac myxoma embolism
searchTerms: brain infarct due to cardiac myxoma

laboratory: Elevated cortisol levels with loss of diurnal variation in PPNAD
imaging: MRI of pituitary gland revealing adenomas
Ultrasound or MRI detecting testicular or thyroid tumors
genetic: Pathogenic variants in PRKAR1A gene detected by molecular genetic testing
other: Histopathology confirming myxomas in cardiac or extracardiac tissues
Skin biopsy showing blue nevi or lentigines

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of gastrointestinal stromal tumors, pulmonary chondromas, and paragangliomas
Lack of cardiac myxomas and spotty skin pigmentation
Parathyroid hyperplasia, pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, pituitary adenomas
Absence of cardiac myxomas and characteristic skin pigmentation

redFlags: Recurrent cardiac myxomas causing embolic events
Early onset endocrine tumors with unusual pigmentation
Family history of cardiac tumors or endocrine neoplasia
references: Stratakis CA. Carney complex: clinical and molecular features. Front Horm Res. 2013;41:50-63.
Carney JA. The complex of myxomas, spotty pigmentation, and endocrine overactivity. Medicine (Baltimore). 1985;64(4):270-283.
Nesterova M, Stratakis CA. Carney complex: clinical features and molecular genetics. Neuroendocrinology. 2014;99(2):125-138.
